## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Hetuduka* (Patthana 8.1) is a text of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The title designates the "root dyad" (*hetuduka*), a foundational Abhidhamma classification that divides all phenomena into those that are root causes (*hetū dhammā*) and those that are not root causes (*na hetū dhammā*) [U Kyaw Khine 1999]. In the conditional methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines how phenomena arise in dependence on roots or non-roots according to conditional relations (such as root condition, *hetupaccaya*), including negative analytical treatments (*hetuduke na-hetuduka*) [Nyanatiloka 2007].
